public_offer.claim_scope: Publisher says it uses anonymous TED Search API v3, official predecessor links and source-backed field deltas; no independent end-to-end delivery audit by AgentMine.
public_offer.billing_caveat: Zero custom event fees on unchanged checks does not prove zero Apify compute/storage/operating cost or zero buyer charges under all circumstances.

platform_visible_usage_counters.caveat: Platform counters are publisher/platform display, not unique paying customers, retention, verified delivered events, or transaction revenue.

competitive_implication: A public event-priced TED amendment and deadline-delta monitor already advertises official-source predecessor tracking and field diffs. Generic change monitoring is not an uncontested wedge; AgentMine must validate incremental supplier decision value or opt-in buyer demand, not compete on catalog size or hypothetical event counts.
